name: Meridian Ironclad
description: Founded in 2191 under HelixCorp sponsorship, the Ironclad play Chrome Combat Football in the IRONWALL LEAGUE out of the Crown District stadium known as the Crucible Bowl. Their roster of military-grade augmented athletes is legendary for offensive line chrome that can absorb impact forces equivalent to a vehicle collision, making them the most-watched team in GLMZ for three consecutive seasons.
story_hooks: A backup player discovers their new augmentation package contains proprietary HelixCorp surveillance hardware that activates during games.
A rival corponation attempts to poach the Ironclad's star quarterback by offering off-the-books augmentation that exceeds league legal limits.
A sportswriter investigating the 2198 settlement goes missing two days before publication of their exposé.
